  Cast Mirror of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.

## Combo 248-372-465
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Changeling Berserker + Wormfang Drake
Color identity: URW | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 4 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Berserker (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Wormfang Drake must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

## Combo 372-465-4846
Cards: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Worldgorger Dragon + Wormfang Drake
Color identity: URW | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Wormfang Drake must be exiled by Abdel Adrian, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.

Color identity: URW | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{U}{R}
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Medomai the Ageless (battlefield); Idris, Soul of the TARDIS (hand); Thrummingbird (battlefield); Encroaching Mycosynth (battlefield)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
  Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
  When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
  Move to your extra turn.
  At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
  Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
  Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
  Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
  Repeat from step 5.

Color identity: URW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{U}{U}
Produces: Infinite triggers from the creature with a tap trigger
Requires: Creature That Triggers on Being Tapped (battlefield)
Start: Ertha Jo, Frontier Mentor (battlefield); Clock of Omens (battlefield); Memnarch (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, giving the creature with a tap trigger the artifact type.
  Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and the creature with a tap trigger, targeting the creature.
  Ertha Jo and the creature trigger.
  Resolve the creature's trigger.
  Resolve the Ertha Jo trigger, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
  Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and the creature tapped in step 2.
  Repeat from step 2.

## Combo 1653-7814
Cards: Tireless Tribe + Inside Out
Color identity: URW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}{U/R}
Produces: Near-infinite damage to one opponent
Start: Tireless Tribe (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Inside Out (hand)
Prerequisites: An opponent cannot block Tireless Tribe.
Steps: Cast Inside Out by paying {1}{U/R}, targeting Tireless Tribe and then drawing a card.
  Activate Tireless Tribe by discarding a card, giving it +4/+0 as its power and toughness are switched.
  Repeat step 2 as able.
  Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tireless Tribe.
Notes: It's recommended to start the combo having a number of cards in hand equal to (X-5)/4, rounded up, where X is the opponent's life total. This'll ensure lethal damage to the opponent.

## Combo 1938-3742-4846
Cards: Worldgorger Dragon + Glorious Protector + Phantom Steed
Color identity: URW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 2 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Phantom Steed (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).
